exceptions.detail: The compressed multiplier reduction in answer 123 and exact finite-size/floor constants in Theorem P-prime/answer 125 were read but not independently closed. In particular, the proof explicitly excludes t < floor(log2(h+1)), while the theorem states an unrounded (log2 g)/3 bound; this rounding step is not certified. The RAM shift-class cardinality and final numerical size estimates in answer 124 are also explicit proof-sketch limits. The cited Brodnik–Miltersen–Munro papers were not re-proved.

Exercises 117,126,128–130 are research exceptions. The Håstad parity-circuit lower bound used in 127 and the external regular-language results are accepted as cited; no independent external proof or literature update was attempted.

The reachability programs and clique update were read through their printed state changes. The queen-graph counts, workspace figures and historical timings were not reproduced, and the full maximal-clique implementation was not independently run. F0023 is a specific hand trace of the intermediate maximal-family invariant.

The full optimum-cost classifications of ternary encodings and answers 136,138,140,142 were not enumerated. Functional formulas and symmetry reductions were reviewed; omitted optimum circuits and the open optimality question in 140 were not reconstructed. The automorphism remark in 136(b) was read in its nontrivial three-or-more-element context, without promoting small-domain caveats.
The Ulam update invariant was checked, but the million/billion-term numerical values, gap claims, empirical clustering and cited near-linear method in the 2020 addendum were not reproduced.

The printed sideways-heap and nearest-common-ancestor constructions were reviewed. External dynamic-forest and navigation-pile performance results, and a full implementation test of all preprocessing/query cases, were not independently reproduced.
